Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

  • **Persistence:** No evidence was found of systemd units, cron jobs, launch agents, shell profile edits, startup folders, or self-reinstall logic. The phrase Startup truncation refers to an observability event-file retention specification and is not a persistence mechanism.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence was found of Kubernetes service-account token use, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, CI publish-token theft, or GitHub Actions workflow injection.
